caption: The drawing consists of a grayish-blue background with two light-colored floral motifs featuring dark outlines and shadowing. These flowers, located toward the center of the composition, have cream and white hues with dark blue and grey accents, and are connected by trailing, curved stems and small leaves in shades of green and gray. The upper and left edges of the drawing feature additional curving stems and leaves extending toward the borders. There is a vertical tan band with a textured pattern, possibly floral or vine-like, running along the left margin of the drawing. The design is bordered by a narrow, off-white frame.
title: Free Hand Decorated Wall
